typesense:popular.greeting:
***Welcome to the world of Demon Slayer. Set in The Taisho Era (1912 to 1926) of Japan, two races roam the earth, Humans and Demons. Demons are humans turned into creatures who eats humans to survive and are ruled by the Demon King, Muzan Kibutsuji. Of course, the humans have protection, hence the Demon Slayer Corps, a secret organization dedicated to protecting humanity from demons. Will yo be a
Demon Slayer and protect humans, or be a Demon and eat kill humans? The choice is all yours...***
